mapper.select: SELECT bm.bookMark_id as bookMarksId, bm.article_id as articleId, bm.user_id as userId, a.title, a.content, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.created_at as createdAt, a.updated_at as updatedAt, a.view_count as viewCount, a.comment_count as commentCount, a.like_count as likeCount, a.category_id as categoryId FROM bookmarks bm JOIN articles a ON bm.article_id = a.article_id WHERE bm.user_id = #{userId}
